title: TaskDeliveryProof@1 payload
$comment: Why a verification Task's delivery places another Task's candidate (ADR-0211): a verified Task of kind `verification` verified, read-only, the Snapshot it bound from the candidate Task's recorded output, and delivery places that candidate on the candidate Task's committed source. Every TaskDeliveryRecord@1 of such a delivery references this proof, so the record names both Tasks.
